name: Khto tse skazav?
source:
Artificial intelligence has become the ruler of the world, imprisoning people in capsules, but their number must be constantly reduced to conserve energy. Therefore, AI invents various tasks: create a new pizza, take part in a gladiatorial fight or... make AI laugh. The latter will be your challenge. "Хто це сказав?" - the story of a young man who, during his trial, must find an approach to AI with megalomania, because his life is at stake.

Does artificial intelligence have a sense of humor? And will it like ours?

[Translated from [url=https://dentistsdjiango.itch.io/htotseskazav]itch.io[/url]]
